description: Hi! We are Laura Mize, M.S., CCC-SLP, and Macy Mize Usher, M.S., CCC-SLP, pediatric speech-language pathologists, and welcome to teachmetotalk.com's youtube channel! Here we help parents and professionals teach toddlers and preschoolers to understand and use language.
